{{Quote|Made from a genuine Bakuran recipe, this pie features creamy namana custard topped with atomically aerated cream.|From the menu of Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex's" />}}
A type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]], '''namana cream pie''' was made with [[namana custard]], which was made from the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] of the [[namana]]<ref name="Dex's" /> [[Tree/Legends|tree]]&mdash;a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> In one recipe, the namana [[Custard/Legends|custard]] used in the [[Pie/Legends|pie]] had a [[Cream/Legends|creamy]] consistency, and the Bakuran dessert was topped with [[atomically aerated cream]].<ref name="Dex's" />

Namana cream pie was served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> In the diner's menu, owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] claimed that he used a genuine Bakuran recipe. The pie was sold at 3.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a slice.<ref name="Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Namana cream pie was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex's" />
